summary: The connected workspace for docs and databases — defended by team inertia and deeply nested relational workflows.
moat: Notion's primary defense is organizational lock-in: entire companies build their operating systems on relational databases, interconnected wikis, and team permissions that AI agents cannot easily clone or migrate without human coordination.

challengers.name: Cursor & AI Workspace Agents
challengers.evidence: Modern AI dev environments and chat agents now generate structured documentation and markdown files directly within local codebases.

challengers.name: Affine & Open-Source Local Docs
challengers.evidence: Local-first, open-source AI workspaces offering offline-ready visual canvases and vector search.
